about.quote: Continuity of care begins by sharing what matters.
about.title: Technology serving a genuine bond.
about.p1: [Project Title] was born as an academic project with a simple premise: medical records should follow the pet, not remain scattered across papers and clinics.
about.p2: We provide a meeting place between families and veterinarians—a place to understand their health story, share it thoughtfully, and ensure continuous care.
about.banner: More context to care. More clarity to accompany.

faq.title:
Clear answers,
right from the start.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our platform and how your pet's data is shared.
faq.disclaimer: [Project Title] organizes health information. It does not replace the professional diagnosis or care of a licensed veterinarian.
faq.q1: Who can see my pet's medical records?
faq.a1: Only you and the veterinary clinics or specialists you have authorized. As the owner, you choose whether they have read-only or editing permissions, and can revoke access anytime.
faq.q2: Can I register more than one pet?
faq.a2: Yes. From a single account you can register dogs, cats, birds and small mammals, and each one gets its own record.
faq.q3: Who adds clinical information to the record?
faq.a3: The vets you have given edit permission to. Every entry is stored with the name of the professional who created or changed it, so you always know who wrote what.
faq.q4: Does it connect to my clinic's software?
faq.a4: Not for now: it does not integrate with clinic management software. Professionals work directly on the website, and the platform offers a documented API so other systems can connect to it in the future.
faq.q5: What information will I find about clinics?
faq.a5: Their specialty, location and ratings from other users, so you can compare them. The directory is curated by hand, so it does not show real-time availability.
